axis.mcp.stdio.description: Advertise axis mcp stdio server via McpServerDefinitionProvider.

axis.mcp.command.markdownDescription: Absolute path or command name for the AXIS CLI used by the MCP stdio provider. When set, skips PATH/`allowNpx` resolution. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace settings cannot redirect the stdio child (which receives `AXIS_API_KEY`).

axis.mcp.allowNpx.markdownDescription: If true and `axis` is not on PATH (and `axis.mcp.command` is empty), advertise `npx -y @hoox-sh/axis-cli` as the MCP stdio command. If false (default), soft-fail: no MCP definition + one warning pointing at `AXIS: Show MCP Config Snippet`. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace cannot enable npx resolution.
